title: Worktree resource isolation: a database and Redis index per packet, a fixture-prefix registry with escaped LIKE cleanup, namespaced public rate-limit keys

Literal fixture values in globally unique columns (User.email, Business.slug, Payment.providerPaymentId, PaymentLink.token, Site.subdomain) must embed the prefix; the spec checks new suites for this.
